h: Revering Parents Awakens the Holiness That Shabbos Completes

p: "This is the general principle of the Torah;
what connection there is between them,
regarding the opening of this parsha,
"the general principle of the Torah," with this.
וְעַל שַׁבָּת כָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
And about Shabbos the Ramban, of blessed memory, writes:
"The warnings about Shabbos are many in the Torah,
is equal to all the mitzvos."
it would have been fitting to write here
and after it the mitzvah of Shabbos,
which is equal to all the mitzvos,
וְגַם מַה שַּׁיָּיכוּת מוֹרָא אַבָּא וְאִמָּא
And also, what is the connection of fearing father and mother,
and why did it put it before everything,
as is written in the Responsa of the Maharil (siman 1),
who would expound every "es" in the Torah;
"Es Hashem your God you shall fear,"
so why did he not withdraw
when he reached "And you shall love es Hashem your God"?
And he answered that there is no limit to love,
"And you shall love your fellow as yourself";
for a person to be lenient with himself
for they brought a person's body into the world;
that is because the main thing for them
and the evil desires of the world;
therefore they honor father and mother,
who brought their body into the world.
This is not so with holy Yisrael:
(for them the main thing is the soul
and not the nations of the world";
that it is the soul that is called "adam,"
and the body is called "the flesh of adam";
and the soul, before it was clothed in the body,
to the desire of this world;
it is better not to have been created than to have been created";
so why should he honor father and mother,
in that they made the body?
Therefore it writes first the mitzvah of Shabbos,
for it is a mitzvah to delight in Shabbos
one brings holiness into the heart,
as it says in Midrash Rabbah
and they said: "You eat and drink
יֵשׁ לָהֶם קְדוּשַּׁת הַגּוּף גַּם כֵּן
have the holiness of the body as well.
the mitzvah of honoring father and mother,
it writes the fear of father and mother;
and how is it possible to fear
any created being in the world
other than Him, may His Name be blessed?
And Rabbi Akiva, who expounded the word es
in that the Torah scholar is full of
the holiness of the glory of His Godliness, may His Name be blessed,
and he is an actual Godly portion,
and his fear of a Torah scholar
is the fear of the Holy One, blessed be He,
for "the fear of your teacher is like the fear of Heaven."
But how is it fitting to fear
that fear of them is compared to the fear of the Omnipresent?
fear of them too is included in the fear of Heaven,
as is written in the Gemara (there, 31b):
when he heard the sound of his mother's footsteps,
he would say: Let me stand up
before the Shechinah that is coming.
For Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
with no unfit one among his seed
all the bodies of the seed of Yaakov
have in them a root of holiness;
(שְׁמוּאֵל ב יד, יד) וְלֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח
and "no banished one will be banished from Him" (Shmuel II 14:14);
a portion in the World to Come,
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א צג, א) אִיתָא
And in the holy Zohar (I 93a) it says:
אַף עַל גַּב דְּהַרְבֵּה פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
even though there are many sinners of Yisrael,
and circumcision is in the flesh
and in the holiness of the body,
and it is upon the father to circumcise him
"before he knows to reject the bad
that is, the beginning of his birth is in holiness.
And this is because the father and mother
there is in them a root of holiness,
and by the power of that root
is the birth of the body of their offspring
also in a root of holiness.
who "will be surnamed by the name of Yisrael" (Yeshayahu 44:5),
have in them an imprint at the root,
a power to bring into their offspring,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
for he is the father of converts.)
And in every father and mother
there is a root of holiness
from Yaakov and from the Imahos;
Knesses Yisrael cleave to Him, may He be blessed,
For they said in Shir HaShirim Rabbah
on the pasuk "And my heart is awake" (Shir HaShirim 5:2)
that the Holy One, blessed be He,
is from the side of the soul
that He breathed into his nostrils,
the body that clothes it is so as well,
for what is joined to the pure is pure.
And the power of father and mother,
who become partners with the Holy One, blessed be He,
is because they are the seed of Yaakov,
דְּנִקְרָא עַל שֵׁם שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
who is called by the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
and his image is engraved on the Throne of Glory;
and they are called sun and moon,
as is explicit in the Torah
and they are the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah;
for the Holy One, blessed be He, is called sun,
and the moon is the Shechinah and Knesses Yisrael.
And because of this, the mitzvah
אֶלָּא מִמִּי שֶׁצִּיוָּה עַל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ כוּ׳
but rather Him Who commanded concerning the Sanctuary, etc."
so the fear of father and mother,
to the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah;
from the pasuk "One who robs his father and his mother" (Mishlei 28:24),
meaning one who robs the Holy One, blessed be He,
(מִשְׁלֵי א, ח) שְׁמַע בְּנִי מוּסַר אָבִיךָ
"Hear, my son, the instruction of your father" (Mishlei 1:8)
this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
"and do not forsake the teaching of your mother"
"Let me stand up before the Shechinah, etc."
And this is the opening of the parsha,
which is "the general principle of the Torah";
for this is the overall intent of the Torah,
"And you shall be to Me a kingdom of Kohanim
as it says at the beginning of Parshas Emor;
and at the time of Mattan Torah,
when they became free of the evil inclination,
For the holiness of which they said
and sanctifying oneself in what is permitted,
and He said this to the entire assembly of Yisrael
after the evil inclination had returned to its place;
And for this it put first
for the fear of father and mother
is on account of the holiness
that is in him by birth from them;
and fear of them also brings
the fear of Heaven into the heart,
and stirs one to bring this holiness
into action, revealed in his heart;
into the hearts of Bnei Yisrael,
"For I am Hashem Who sanctifies you";
and it put the fear of father and mother first,
the Holy One, blessed be He, sanctifies them
with the mitzvah of the holiness of Shabbos,
which is a good gift to Yisrael.
since they do not have the holiness of the Avos
even if one rests on Shabbos,
"an idolater who keeps a Shabbos is liable"
וְלֹא דַּי שֶׁלֹּא יַשִּׂיג שׁוּם קְדוּשָּׁה
and not only does he attain no holiness,
does the Holy One, blessed be He, sanctify
because they are a holy seed.
Therefore it put the fear of father and mother
